tasks.title: Confirm and preserve the Slice 1 repository baseline
acceptance_criteria: Branch, commit, dirty paths, overlap rules, and excluded paths are reviewed before implementation.
No pre-existing change is reset, overwritten, deleted, or reformatted as a side effect.
risks: The working tree may change after this draft baseline was captured.

tasks.title: Define graph contracts without creating a second ontology
acceptance_criteria: Contracts cover artifact nodes, canonical outbound edges, evidence, parse issues, graph issues, and index results.
Relationship types are consumed from canonical MDS policy rather than redefined as a competing list.
risks: Canonical orphan and cycle semantics still require architect/KC clarification.

tasks.title: Parse current MDS frontmatter relationship forms
acceptance_criteria: Fixtures cover scalar metadata, list relationships, nested maps, and list-of-object links.
Malformed YAML is returned as a parse issue and is not silently truncated.
risks: Selecting a YAML dependency may modify the lockfile and requires review of packaging/security impact.

tasks.title: Normalize declared relationships to canonical outbound edges
acceptance_criteria: Supported input forms produce one normalized relationship structure.
No inverse alias such as implemented_by is persisted as a new relationship type.
risks: Legacy metadata aliases may need an explicit compatibility decision.

tasks.title: Build a deterministic in-memory graph projection
acceptance_criteria: Valid unique artifacts become nodes and valid relationships become edges.
Equivalent inputs produce equivalent nodes, edges, and issue ordering.
The builder does not write source artifacts or introduce persistence.
risks: Unstable ordering can make rebuild evidence unreliable.

tasks.title: Retain source evidence for every graph edge
acceptance_criteria: Each edge identifies source path, YAML field path, raw target value, and origin.
Line positions are retained when the selected parser can provide them and otherwise reported as unavailable.
risks: Some YAML parsers discard source locations unless AST/document APIs are used.

tasks.title: Report duplicate IDs and broken references without discarding valid graph data
acceptance_criteria: Duplicate IDs and missing targets include actionable source evidence.
Valid unrelated nodes and edges remain in the projection when a non-fatal issue exists.
risks: Duplicate-ID winner selection must be deterministic and must not imply approval.

tasks.title: Validate relationship policy and governed cycles
acceptance_criteria: Non-canonical relationship types are reported.
Cycle checks apply only to policy-governed DAG relationships and do not reject all reference cycles.
Unresolved orphan semantics are reported as unverified rather than invented.
risks: Current policy names the primary lineage as a DAG but does not fully enumerate every cycle-permitted edge.

tasks.title: Demonstrate the graph projection on an isolated EduMeet seed copy
acceptance_criteria: The test copies the seed to a temporary project and never modifies workspace source files.
The report includes deterministic node and edge counts.
The known missing target BA-REQ-EDU-AI-001 is reported with evidence.
risks: Seed content may change; assertions should preserve intended behavior without hiding new issues.

tasks.title: Produce Slice 1 Definition of Done evidence for the next gate
acceptance_criteria: Fresh typecheck, build, parser, graph, policy, integration, and source-preservation evidence is recorded.
Unverified items, ontology incompatibilities, residual risks, and pre-existing changes remain visible.
The report requests a human decision and does not approve Slice 2 automatically.
risks: A green command is insufficient if evidence is not tied to the current commit and working tree.
